Container.Name: Prusa-Connect
Container.Overview: Self-hosted local Prusa Connect server for managing Prusa 3D printers on your LAN without relying on Prusa's cloud. Uses Prusa Research's official Docker image. First-time setup is completed in the browser. This Unraid template is independently maintained and not officially maintained by Prusa Research.

Config.Name: WebUI / API / Printer Port
Config.Description: Host TCP port for the web interface, REST API, and printer connections; container port is 8080.

Config.Name: Configuration and Database
Config.Description: Writable first-run setup, authentication database, resource overlay and history. REQUIRED: Create this host directory and chown it to UID/GID 10001:10001 BEFORE clicking Apply. See Additional Requirements.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent application and extension data. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Persistent application files. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Uploaded print files and local storage. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Temporary Files
Config.Description: Writable scratch space required by the read-only root filesystem; host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.
